company_overview: Postman is an API platform that enables software engineers and enterprise organizations to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs. The platform simplifies each step of the API lifecycle while providing contract-first governance, collaboration features, and security controls.
target_audience: Individual developers, software engineering teams, and enterprise organizations building and managing APIs.
leadership: Abhinav Asthana (CEO and co-founder); Ankit Sobti (co-founder); Abhijit Kane (co-founder)

company_overview: Supabase provides an open source backend platform built around a Postgres database. Its suite of tools includes authentication, data APIs, edge functions, realtime data, storage, and vector embeddings.
target_audience: Developers and engineering teams building web and mobile applications.
leadership: Tracy Lane (General Counsel); Paul Copplestone; Ant Wilson

company_overview: Vapi provides a unified voice AI platform and real-time audio infrastructure for building, testing, and deploying enterprise-ready voice agents. Its technology handles orchestration, conversation flows, latency, and telephony integrations to support scalable automated phone and web interactions.
target_audience: Developers and enterprise teams building, testing, and scaling voice AI applications.
